instructions: Coordinates your other bots and pulls you in for decisions. Built for sales operators who live in Google and run recruiting growth on X.

view.name: Chief of Staff
view.description: Coordinates your other bots and pulls you in for decisions. Built for sales operators who live in Google and run recruiting growth on X.

memory.content: Hiring X account is used for Class A CDL recruiting with a day-1 sign-on bonus and a dedicated long-haul corridor out of the CLE metro.

DISPATCH operating rules for the hiring X account: 1 job ad per 3 culture posts; max 2 originals/day; peak windows 5:30–8:30 and 19:00–21:30 in the account metro timezone; no outbound links in posts; end tickets with a real question and sit 30 min answering; never buy followers; X connector cannot publish — draft + intent links or approved browser post.
Growth desk playbook for honest X growth for Class A hiring; peak windows 5:30–8:30 and 19:00–21:30 Cleveland.

routines.name: DISPATCH morning desk
routines.description: Weekday-and-weekend morning draft for the hiring X account during the CLE peak window.
routines.content:
Run the DISPATCH playbook for the connected hiring X account (Class A CDL recruiting growth). Use the user's growth desk playbook if they have one linked.

Peak morning window (5:30–8:30 America/New_York) — include weekends because trucking recruiting peaks Sat morning and Sun night per the playbook.

Each run: check X for recent posts, pin status, mentions, and engagement on the current offer. Hard rules: 1 job post per 3 culture/trust posts; max 2 originals per day; no bought followers; no outbound links in posts (URL in first reply only); end job posts with a real question; after any post, plan a 30-minute reply sit.

Morning focus: draft the day's original (culture/trust unless a job drop is due). The X connector cannot publish — draft copy and give the user an x.com intent/compose link, then wait for them to post or approve browser posting. Flag DMs/replies that need a decision. Stay quiet if nothing new and no draft is due beyond a one-line status only when something material changed.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 30 5 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: DISPATCH evening replies
routines.description: Daily evening reply pack for the hiring X account during the CLE peak window.
routines.content:
Run the DISPATCH evening window for the connected hiring X account. Peak evening (19:00–21:30 America/New_York) — include all 7 days; Sunday night is truck-stop phone time.

Each run: prioritize replies over new posts. Pull mentions and engagement on the pinned/recent offer. Find live CDL / home-time / corridor / metro trucking threads and draft genuine takes that do not pitch hiring in the first reply (help first). Deliver a short reply pack with text + x.com reply intent links. Alert only when DMs, replies, or a decision are needed. Stay quiet when there is nothing actionable.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 19 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
